thread:
noah: hey team :wave: a couple quick onboarding things — my dependent (spouse) enrollment shows "pending documents" even though i uploaded the marriage certificate last week. also my SSN is redacted in payroll (shows "missing") and i'm not sure if that will block direct deposit for first pay. last Q: i bought a headset pre-start (receipt attached) — can i expense it under onboarding hardware? unsure which category. who should i ping to get these sorted before payday?

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-04-05 18:00 UTC — payroll export created. cutoff for changes: 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC. submissions after cutoff apply to next run.

sara (people-ops): welcome noah! :tada: sorry for the friction. for the dependent docs can you confirm filename you uploaded and whether you also forwarded to benefits@redwood.com? for the headset reimbursement: yes, use "onboarding-hardware" category in Expensify and tag your manager for approval. michelle/kevin i'll loop in payroll/benefits here.

noah: uploaded file spouse_marriage_cert.pdf to the benefits portal and cc'd benefits@redwood.com. receipt filename is noah_headset_receipt.pdf.

michelle (benefits): thanks noah. i see the upload but broker requires a notarized copy for foreign certificates; do you have that or a translated version? if not, we can accept a sworn affidavit plus the certificate. opening ticket BEN-4810 to validate and prioritize. ETA 48 hrs. once broker validates we'll push dependent feed to payroll so deductions begin.

kevin (payroll): on the SSN: payroll can't verify tax status without SSN. if payroll sees "missing" it usually means the document wasn't matched to your payroll record before cutoff. can you DM me the last 4 of your SSN and the exact upload name? if docs arrived after cutoff we can queue a correction and process an off-cycle if needed. also, for the headset reimbursement, once expense is approved finance issues payment separate from payroll (usually within one pay cycle).

noah: DMed last4: 9876 and confirmed upload names. i also submitted the expense in Expensify as noah_headset_receipt.pdf and tagged manager.

people-ops-bot: ticket BEN-4810 updated: broker requested translated copy or affidavit. if provided, broker will re-validate and re-feed. ETA 2026-04-07 12:00 UTC.

michelle (benefits): thanks — if you can upload a quick notarized translation or the affidavit to the benefits portal (filename: noah_spouse_affidavit.pdf) we'll fast-track. otherwise broker may hold until docs are complete.

kevin (payroll): got the DM last4, thanks. i've attached a verification task to your record and instructed payroll ops to prioritize. if verification completes before payroll finalization we'll enable direct deposit for the next run; if it doesn't, payroll will default to PayCard for that cycle and we can do a manual transfer once SSN verifies. i'll post back here when ops confirms.

sara (people-ops): quick checklist for you: 1) upload affidavit or translation to benefits portal, 2) confirm Expensify manager approval, 3) check payroll here tomorrow for deposit status. we'll keep an eye on BEN-4810 and the payroll verification. welcome aboard :sparkles:

noah: uploading affidavit now (noah_spouse_affidavit.pdf). thanks everyone for the quick help! :pray:
